reason: I saw a TikTok about a no-proof settlement and my first thought was I am not handing my identity to some startup called lawsuitai.org. These 'free money' sites are scams until proven otherwise, and free-during-beta with an account is exactly how they harvest you.
objection: I don't want a startup storing my identity details — and I don't believe a random site that admits its listings aren't even verified.
would_change_my_mind: If I could browse and open the official administrator's claim form with no account and no personal information stored by you, and I already recognized that administrator's name.
